profile.headline: Software Engineer at Prudential Financial
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Hi there! My name is Deyby, and I'm from New York. I'm passionate about working with all things related to the web. Whether I'm working on a Front-End, a Back-End, or a REST API, I usually tend to have a good time!

I'm currently studying Computer Science at CUNY Hunter College. Simultaneously, I'm also participating in a variety of external opportunities that focus on Computer Science. Some of these include Google's Code Next, and All Star Code, just to name a few. When I'm not busy with school or extracurriculars, I spend my spare time working on personal projects, listening to music, taking pictures, and biking.

I'm always open to take on opportunities where I can not only use and improve my technical skills, but also meet other like-minded people who I can make great contributions to the world with.

Aside from Full-Stack Web Development, I'm also interested in Computer Science Education, Data Analytics and the Finance industry.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Newark, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented data transformation from internal platforms into client facing proposal
documents using Java and Spring Boot.

- Combined underwriting web components to be hosted in a single application server, reducing costs by 66% using React, NodeJS, and Nginx.

- Created and maintained Continuous Integration & Continuous Deployment pipelines and Infrastructure as Code to build and deploy apps in AWS Cloud.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Back-End Web Development · Jenkins · React · TypeScript · Agile Methodologies · XML · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · npm · JFrog Software · Artifactory

positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site

positions.title: Resident Assistant, Chelsea
positions.description:
- Worked directly with property managers to address inquiries for 300+ residents, coordinate unit maintenance, and resolve housing-related concerns.

- Assisted in tracking, reporting, and following up on maintenance requests to ensure timely completion and resident satisfaction.

- Supported front desk operations by handling inquiries, check-ins, and administrative tasks with professionalism and efficiency.

positions.title: Resident Assistant, Turtle Bay
positions.description:
- Provide customer service by assisting 1500+ residents with inquiries, concerns, and requests at the front desk, creating a welcoming and supportive environment.

- Conduct regular rounds to monitor the residence halls, ensuring compliance with housing policies.

- Perform logging, organization and distribution of incoming mail and packages for residents.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Newark, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Developed a project with Python to automate the processing and analysis of data from multiple sources, significantly reducing manual effort and improving efficiency for software currency program critical to preventing ransomware compromise.

- Designed a granular analytics methodology that correlates device type, hostname, and agent version, providing actionable insights to enhance remediation strategies and improve the overall effectiveness of endpoint security.

- Contributed to the future development roadmap by working towards enabling on-demand data access via API integration with platforms like Microsoft Defender, and consolidating individual scripts into a master script and REST API endpoint to streamline data delivery to platforms such as PowerBI.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Information Technology Infrastructure · Python (Programming Language) · Data Analysis · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Newark, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Collaborated with senior engineers in development of internal Python-based REST APIs.

- Aided in agile development of automated incident handling system, saving over 350 manual hours yearly.

- Engaged in a diverse range of educational and networking workshops facilitated by senior level staff, including C-level executives.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Microsoft Power BI · Python (Programming Language) · DevOps · Bitbucket

positions.title: Code Next Coach
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Supported development of internal curriculums in iOS Development with Swift.

- Assisted in the delivery of curriculums in React, Deep Learning and Full-Stack Web Development with Python to over 40 students

- Provided individual advising to over 15 students on projects, programming concepts and technical career preparation.

- Assisted with providing maintenance to the classroom space and the technology within.
positions.insights: Skills: React · Flask · Responsive Web Design · Swift (Programming Language) · JavaScript · Computer Science Education · Entrepreneurship Education · Python (Programming Language) · iOS Development

positions.title: Launch Program Participant
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description: Skills: Data Analysis · Interviewing · Software Development · Networking · TypeScript

positions.title: University Ambassador
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description:
Jopwell advances careers for Black, Latinx, and Native American students and professionals. Our career advancement platform connects members with companies who know that representation matters.

- Developed relationships with students on campus by email, text, social media, and campus events.

- Collaborated with Jopwell’s Community and Marketing team to expand Jopwell’s mission on campus through informational and skill building virtual events.

- Established, developed, and maintained relationships with campus leaders and administrators.
positions.insights: Skills: Article Writing · Leadership · Education · Newsletter · Event Planning · Networking

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description:
- Assisted instructional team in the delivery of a web development curriculum to 40+ high school students. 

- Led instruction of curriculum modules at least 3 times per week.

- Led office hours, where I assisted students with reviewing topics covered in class and with their projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Education · Responsive Web Design · JavaScript · Computer Science · HTML5

positions.title: Teaching Fellow
positions.description:
- Participated in the delivery of a computer science fundamentals curriculum to 30+ high school students at The Renaissance Charter School.

- Introduced students to creative coding and hardware programming with Python.

- Managed classroom logistics, such as attendance and grading.
positions.insights: Skills: Education · Computer Hardware · Computer Science · Python (Programming Language) · Microcontrollers

company.name: Emerging Leaders in Technology and Engineering, Inc.

positions.title: Full-Stack Development Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated with senior developers in the design and development of the Minos Labs website. Also assisted in the improvement of the company’s student platform and other backend systems.

Through collaborative development, I have gained more experience in working with React, Firebase, and the related technologies. I have also gained more experience in responsive web design and version control.

positions.title: Teaching Fellow
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Assisted instructional team in the delivery of a web development curriculum to 40+ high school students.

- Managed virtual classroom logistics, such as attendance and grading of student projects.

- Designed and delivered a lesson on the basics of React, which became a part of the All Star Code Resource Library.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Education · React.js · Responsive Web Design · JavaScript · Computer Science · HTML5

positions.title: Code Next Student
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
Year-round Computer Science program in which I have acquired a variety of skills centered around software development and computer science. Aside from learning more about computer science, I have also learned more about my field through mentorship experiences, and have learned more about entrepreneurship.

Within Code Next, I have also participated in other activities, such as Hackathons. Furthermore, I've been able to take advantage of new opportunities as a result of my membership.

positions.title: Virtual Learning Assistant
positions.locationName: Central Islip, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Provided tech support to students and families within the Central Islip School District.

Helped families to become better acquainted with online learning software used by the Central Islip School District. Online learning technologies included Google Classroom, Castle Learning, and more.

positions.title: Summer Intensive Student
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description:
Summertime Computer Science program in which I acquired various web development specific skills. Aside from learning about web development, I also learned about computer science fundamentals, entrepreneurship, finance, and more.

Since then, I have remained as an active alumni network member, participating in other All Star Code sponsored programs and activities, such as Hackathons.
